notes.title: Map Editor Update
notes.content:
Hello Wargamers!

A small update was released for the Map Editor. This would address any issues you may have been having with the editor. 

As always, if any continued issues, please feel free to reach out!

tags.bug: This would address any issues you may have been having with the editor.

notes.title: Update 4.0
notes.content:
-Added hotfix for missing engine.exe.
You should start seeing a redirect to the "Purchase page" for the game engine, versus missing exe error.

notes.title: Notes for live patch 1.0
notes.content:
Frameworks for installer and path correction tool retargeted. 
-If you were having an issue with the client hanging or freezing, the install package was updated to display progress of install instead of running in the background.
